name: Hakim Rushdie
source:
One of the Shamsu kingdom's successors, second-in-line to inherit the throne after his brother. He has a single-mindedly earnest and arrogant personality.

His character is that of a born leader. He wants everything to go according to his plans, and will stop at nothing to make that happen.

[translated from official site]
